title: Consulting Skills for AI Projects
description: Naming an expectation gap out loud, in the room, before it hardens into someone's success metric — the specific consulting skill this module trains, separate from any technical work.

title: Scoping and Pricing
description: Turning a vague enquiry into a scoped, priced, bounded piece of work — enumerating the distinct projects a single sentence could mean, choosing a pricing structure with an honest view of where each one bites, and writing down what's explicitly not included before someone assumes it is.

title: Setting Expectations That Hold
description: Setting expectations early enough that they don't harden into someone's unscoped success metric — naming the unstated number in the sponsor's head, saying what won't happen before anyone assumes it, and designing pilots and demos that prove something rather than just impress someone.

title: Explaining AI to People Who Don't Care How It Works
description: Explaining capability and limits to a non-technical decision-maker without hype or condescension — a compressed mechanism explanation, analogies checked for what they quietly mislead about, admitting an error rate and staying hired, writing for the reader who only sees the forward, and holding steady with the executive who read one article.

title: People, Politics and Resistance
description: Working with the people whose jobs the automation touches, rather than around them — reading resistance as information, finding the person who remembers why the last attempt failed, naming job-loss fear directly, working the gap between what a sponsor wants and what users will actually adopt, and recognizing when the politics make a project undeliverable as framed.

title: Delivering and Closing
description: Closing an engagement so the work survives the consultant's departure and the client can say plainly what they got — acceptance criteria agreed in writing, a final report that doesn't need a guide, a real handover of ownership, a follow-up that catches drift before it becomes a support call, and turning one finished engagement into the next one.
